title: 8 Things Every
<g>Draft</g> Carries
subtitle: Before it reaches my inbox. Missing one? It doesn't get in.

cards.title: Which room made it
cards.body: Sales, delivery, growth. One room, one job.

cards.title: Which client it's for
cards.body: Every client has their own space and rules.

cards.title: What it wants to do
cards.body: Send, publish, invoice or deploy. Named up front.

cards.title: Who it's about
cards.body: One id per person across every table. No duplicates.

cards.title: The draft itself
cards.body: The email, post or report, ready to approve as is.

cards.title: Why it should go out
cards.body: A plain reason, and which guideline it bent, if any.

cards.title: Money at stake
cards.body: So I know what a yes really costs before I click.

cards.title: The critic's score
cards.body: Graded against my best past work, three fixes max.
